title: merchantframe
summary: Merchant money, row projection, paging, shell, live vendor portrait, current-Benilla zero-discount repair arithmetic, release-owned repair interaction, exact GameText/WowSkin item-hover rendering, repair tooltip/button states, protocol bodies, and shared tooltip money pass bounded deterministic checks. The player update-field snapshot now scans all twelve build-5875 buyback GUID/price/timestamp descriptors, filters incomplete entries, stably orders oldest-first, preserves physical 69-80 wire slots, fills the unpaged twelve-row Buyback tab, and exposes the newest row in the merchant-page recent-buyback slot without altering the protected vendor-main presentation. BenillaMerchantFrame is registered in the global left UIPanel coordinator, so competing registered panels replace it through its native close callback and Escape/center/fullscreen closure uses the same authority. Current Benilla explicitly identifies MoneyFrame.xml as an addon compatibility kit not consumed by its eight authored money windows, so it creates no vendor-main presentation delta. Remaining work is current-Benilla's own deferred drag-buy/shared cursor-item authority, authenticated buyback verification, and human acceptance.
